name: mangal-royal-studio
description: Mangal Royal Studio — Jewellery E-Commerce Platform (Shopify Liquid Theme Storefront + Custom Express Backend + Next.js Custom Admin Dashboard)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@mrs/shared && npm run build --workspace=@mrs/api && npm run build --workspace=@mrs/admin && npm run build --workspace=@mrs/storefront
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@mrs/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@mrs/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=@mrs/admin && npm run typecheck --workspace=@mrs/storefront
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@mrs/shared && npm run test --workspace=@mrs/api
